svg.title: Portable plugin components and host-specific additions
svg.desc: An Agent Plugins 1.0 root manifest packages skills and optionally MCP configuration. This fixture includes the one-file release-note skill and resource-backed csv-analysis skill plus a Copilot-namespaced agent and hook. It does not configure an MCP server. Host-specific components are not universally portable.
